## Label.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `for` :: The id of the control this label names. Sets the native for attribute.
- `size` :: The label scale: text size.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the "Optional" marker; muted by default so it trails the label instead of competing with it.
- `required` :: Draws a red asterisk after the label. The control itself must still carry the required attribute.
- `optional` :: Draws a muted "Optional" after the label, for fields that may be left empty.
- `disabled` :: Dims the label to match a disabled control.
- `children` :: The label text.
